fit.status: v7 audited global replay with current-tier repair and guarded records
fit.selection: The club retains 85% of an ordinary same-confederation cross-border result; this prevents association coefficients from stretching well-connected European leagues far apart while preserving a regional bridge. Cross-tier cup evidence is split between the clubs and the two tier levels around an 80-point baseline gap, with every association's tier-one effect fixed at zero so domestic cups cannot create a global league offset. The published lower estimate subtracts 1.25 standard errors: still conservative, without letting modern match-density differences dominate cross-era records. Complete 2025/26 league files repair current promotion and relegation states. Identity, shootout, historical-jurisdiction and world-record eligibility checks run before publication. Full replay metrics are regenerated with every installation.
